method: Use original raw000004-check.cpuprofile for49 and52, not whole-run profiles. Sum each sample timeDelta exactly once for exclusive/self attribution. Each phase has its own denominator.
Inclusive target samples use a Set of actual ancestor labels, so recursive frames do not multiply a sample within one target. Inclusive target totals overlap and must not be added.

Helper self samples with visible IndexLookup.find-family ancestry are recorded separately; absent/inlined frames can leave attribution incomplete. These are not exact native-call counts or isolated dispatch costs.
Generated declarations compared directly between the retained pinned49 and52 images. No compiler execution or new profile was performed.
sourceFindings: String.eq is already the JavaScript intrinsic (a,b)=>a===b in both images. It is not a source-level Unicode-comparison loop. A separate equality-call overhead explanation is unproven by these samples.

IndexLookup.find.position is a generated pattern dispatch extracting MNode.pos (otherwise0), not a JavaScript intrinsic. find.go calls it on each chosen child before Map.bit; leaf handling calls String.eq and find.leaf. Recursive traversal uses run_named2. These are concrete extra call boundaries to investigate, not a measured explanation of the normal-series slowdown.
Map.bit is already a native JavaScript codePointAt-based implementation returning a Tuple. Inlined allocation/computation can be charged to find.go or a host wrapper instead of its own label.
limitations: These profiles come from different times and are instrumented. Do not use their wall/self-time differences to establish normal52 speedup or intrinsic regression.
Self attribution can include inlined callee work. Profile percentages are worker sampling shares, not whole-process CPU or actual call-volume percentages.
An observed aggregate host-load increase does not prove unrelated external work: compiler JIT/GC threads can contribute, and the cause remains unresolved.
The existing normal ABBA series observed52 slower but overlaps a middle-run load spike. No additional heavy runs were launched.
